source.title: A Kind of Peace
source.description:
I am using most of my waning strength to appear to you.

There is one fleeting hope. You may not be able to save the man, but you may still bring him some measure of peace by limiting the harm he can inflict. Mograine has returned to Naxxramas to recover and resurrect the horsemen. When that's done, his fury will be terrible.

It is wrong to ask this of you after all you've done... but please, confront the Spirit of Mograine. Do what you can to stop him, if only for now. I can help you reach him.
source.objective:
The Will of the Ashbringer is using the last of its power to create a connection to Alexandros Mograine inside of Naxxramas. Take the portal and confront the Spirit of Mograine.

Should you fall in battle, make your way back to the portal within Light's Hope Chapel to re-enter Naxxramas.
source.progress: <The spirit before flickers in and out of existence. It doesn't have much time left.>
source.completion:
It is... done-- for now. I can feel this form... beginning to fade. Thank you--<class>. The blade... remains corrupted but... perhaps... there is another who can...

In the meantime... keep it safe.

Before I... fade completely--one small glimmer of light remains... that I can give...
